title: noDelivery (D-033): an app whose delivery fees aren't entered keeps its pickup and loses only its delivery channel
dataNote: The base state (Domino's: large pizza + 2 L Coke). In the app, forEngine sets noDelivery on its copy when only an app's delivery inputs are null; here it's set directly.

work: r01's ranking without dd-d: direct-p 30.70, dd-p 35.19, ue-p 35.19 (tie keeps CHANNELS order), ue-d 45.10.
dd-d (46.10 in r01) is left out, never priced at $0.
food = 26.98 × 1.153 = 31.10794 → 31.11; app pickup has no fees
Pickup reads none of the delivery inputs, so null delFee, svcMin and memberMin change nothing: as dd-p, 35.19.
noDelivery false is the same as missing: ue-d is r01's 45.10 (1.99 delivery + 4.67 service).
Only the boolean true removes the channel: the string "yes" leaves ue-d available, 45.10.
noDelivery is read for the apps only; direct availability is plats.direct.on and rest.directDelivery. direct-p 30.70 as r01.
